ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  The Board of Directors of AB Cotspin India Limited approved the routine re-appointment of its cost auditor for FY 2026-27. More significantly, the Board approved a proposed change of the company's name to 'ABC Industries India Limited,' pending shareholder approval, which indicates a potential strategic rebranding or diversification beyond its current textile-focused operations. No immediate red flags are apparent, as the changes are disclosed and subject to standard governance procedures.
